name: How much water can I save with a water-efficient bathroom upgrade?

mainEntity.name: How much water can I save with a water-efficient bathroom upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The amount of water saved varies significantly based on current fixture efficiency and household usage. Replacing an old toilet with a high-efficiency model can save thousands of gallons annually. For example, upgrading from a 3.5 gallon per flush (GPF) toilet to a 1.28 GPF model makes a substantial difference. We can help you identify the specific potential savings during an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water savings vary, but upgrading to high-efficiency fixtures like a 1.28 GPF toilet can save thousands of gallons annually. Specific savings can be determined during a consultation.
